modalLead: Config forgets an old tab after five minutes, and a whole Tag suggestions row opens its group.

items.text: Every section opens on its first tab when you were last there more than five minutes ago. Come back sooner and it shows the tab you had open.
A link to Status page or Unraid always names the tab it shows.
Click anywhere on a Tag suggestions row to see the bookmarks it means, not only on the count.
